jira_summaries.title: Comment and mention support
jira_summaries.business_objective: Enable users to comment on issues and mention other users for collaboration and communication.
key_requirements: Allow users to add comments to issues.
Support @mention functionality to notify specific users.
Display comment threads in chronological order.
Ensure notifications are sent to mentioned users.
major_implementation_details: Integrate comment storage with issue records.
Implement user mention parsing and notification triggers.
Update UI to display comments and mentions.
Ensure permission checks for commenting and mentioning.
jira_summaries.contextualized_summary: This ticket introduces the ability for users to comment on issues and mention other users, enhancing team collaboration. The feature is important for improving communication and ensuring relevant stakeholders are notified. Expected behavior includes threaded comments and real-time notifications for mentions. The impacted area is the issue detail view and notification system. Testing should verify comment creation, mention notifications, and permission enforcement.

jira_summaries.title: Duplicate record detection
jira_summaries.business_objective: Prevent the creation of duplicate records to maintain data integrity and reduce redundancy.
key_requirements: Detect duplicate records during creation and update.
Provide user feedback when a duplicate is detected.
Allow users to review and resolve duplicates.
Log duplicate detection events for auditing.
major_implementation_details: Implement duplicate detection logic in backend.
Integrate with record creation and update workflows.
Update UI to display duplicate warnings.
jira_summaries.contextualized_summary: This ticket addresses the need to detect and prevent duplicate records, which is critical for data quality. The system should alert users when a duplicate is found and provide options to resolve it. The feature impacts data entry forms and backend validation logic. Testing should focus on various duplicate scenarios and user notification accuracy.

jira_summaries.title: API usage analytics dashboard
jira_summaries.business_objective: Provide visibility into API usage patterns to support monitoring and optimization.
key_requirements: Display API call counts and trends over time.
Show usage by endpoint and user.
Support filtering by date range and API key.
Visualize errors and response times.
major_implementation_details: Aggregate API usage data in analytics backend.
Integrate with existing authentication and logging.
Ensure data refresh and export capabilities.
jira_summaries.contextualized_summary: This ticket introduces an analytics dashboard for API usage, enabling stakeholders to monitor and optimize API consumption. The dashboard should present key metrics and trends, impacting the analytics and reporting modules. Testing should verify data accuracy, filtering, and visualization.

jira_summaries.title: User onboarding checklist
jira_summaries.business_objective: Streamline the onboarding process for new users to improve adoption and reduce support requests.
key_requirements: Present a checklist of onboarding tasks to new users.
Track completion status of each task.
Provide guidance and links for each step.
Allow users to revisit the checklist.
major_implementation_details: Design checklist UI for onboarding flow.
Enable admin configuration of checklist items.
jira_summaries.contextualized_summary: This ticket aims to implement a user onboarding checklist, helping new users get started efficiently. The checklist will guide users through essential setup steps, impacting the onboarding and user profile modules. Testing should ensure checklist accuracy, progress tracking, and user experience.

jira_summaries.title: Bookmark favorite items
jira_summaries.business_objective: Allow users to bookmark items for quick access and improved productivity.
key_requirements: Enable bookmarking of items from list and detail views.
Display a list of bookmarked items in user profile.
Support unbookmarking and reordering.
Persist bookmarks across sessions.
major_implementation_details: Add bookmark functionality to item models.
Update UI to show bookmark actions.
Ensure performance with large bookmark lists.
jira_summaries.contextualized_summary: This ticket introduces bookmarking, allowing users to save favorite items for easy access. The feature enhances user productivity and impacts item listing and user profile modules. Testing should cover bookmark creation, removal, and persistence.

jira_summaries.title: Advanced filtering support

key_requirements: Support multi-criteria filtering on lists.
Allow users to save and reuse filter presets.

major_implementation_details: Extend backend APIs for advanced filtering.
Develop filter UI and preset management.
jira_summaries.contextualized_summary: This ticket adds advanced filtering capabilities, enabling users to refine data views efficiently. The feature is important for usability and impacts list views and backend APIs. Testing should focus on filter accuracy, performance, and user experience.

jira_summaries.title: Bulk user import support
jira_summaries.business_objective: Enable administrators to import multiple users efficiently, reducing manual entry.

jira_summaries.title: Application audit log generation

Develop UI for log viewing and export.
Ensure compliance with data retention policies.
jira_summaries.contextualized_summary: This ticket implements audit log generation, essential for compliance and operational transparency. The feature impacts logging, storage, and admin UI modules. Testing should ensure log completeness, security, and searchability.
